channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russia’s Africa Corps killed Mali civilians in air strike: HRW
item.description: Russian paramilitaries fight alongside Malian soldiers battling multiple armed groups linked to al-Qaeda and ISIL.

item.title: IRGC strikes US targets in Kuwait a day after US hits Iran: Latest events
item.description: Iran says it struck Kuwait in retaliation for US strikes on multiple locations in Iran, including Qeshm island.

item.title: Israeli forces blow up structures near Lebanon’s Beaufort Castle
item.description: Israel claims army blew up Hezbollah tunnels in southern Lebanon, amid reports of blasts near UNESCO-listed fortress.

item.title: Iran war live: Hamas agree draft peace plan on Gaza
item.description: Hamas deal is conditional on Israel's full withdrawal from Gaza

item.title: Hamas says it has agreed to disarm after Trump announces Board of Peace plan
item.description: A senior Hamas official has told the BBC they have agreed to the Board of Peace's plan. Israel has not commented.

item.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
item.description: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

item.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
item.description: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

item.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
item.description: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.

item.title: Cyanide in tomato pesticide killed 15 elephants, Kenyan officials suspect
item.description: Foul play is ruled out in the record number of elephant deaths for decades in this area of southern Kenya.

item.title: Salman Rushdie attacker convicted of terror offences
item.description: Hadi Matar, 28, was convicted of attempting to help Hezbollah by attacking the British-Indian author.
